instructions.task: Identify the single intent of this customer message sent to a digital bank's support chat.
instructions.guidance: Pick the option whose meaning and examples best match what the customer is asking about. Distinguish carefully by the transaction type (card payment, cash withdrawal, transfer, top-up, direct debit) and by the situation (pending, declined, fee charged, not recognised, wrong exchange rate, reverted).

activate_my_card.meaning: How to activate a card, or activation not working.
examples: How do I activate my card?
i cant seem to activate card

age_limit.meaning: Minimum age to open or use an account; accounts for children/teens.
examples: what is the age limit?
Can my kids have an account?

apple_pay_or_google_pay.meaning: Using Apple Pay, Google Pay, Apple Watch or Android pay with the card, including topping up via Apple Pay.
examples: Can I top up with Apple Pay?
Does Google Pay work?

atm_support.meaning: Where to find an ATM, which ATMs accept the card, using the card at ATMs in general.
examples: Where is the closest ATM?
Which ATMs take this card?

automatic_top_up.meaning: The auto top-up feature: enabling, how it works, stopping it.
examples: Is auto top up available?

balance_not_updated_after_bank_transfer.meaning: A bank transfer (e.g. from a UK account or another bank) into or out of the customer's account was completed but is not showing up / balance not updated, including when they also ask how long it usually takes.
examples: What's the time frame for a UK account transfer? I just made one and it's not showing up anywhere.
I did a transfer but the balance is the same.
My friend sent me money but it isn't showing in my balance

balance_not_updated_after_cheque_or_cash.meaning: Money the customer deposited or put into the account (cash, cheque, or just 'money I put in') has not appeared in the balance yet, or is slow to clear.
examples: I am still awaiting the money I put into my account this morning.
I recently deposited some money into my account, but it isn't showing up.
I deposited a cheque but I don't see the funds
My cheque is slow to cash

beneficiary_not_allowed.meaning: Cannot add a beneficiary/payee, a beneficiary is not allowed, or the customer is not able to transfer to a particular account.
examples: I need to transfer to my account and cant.
Why is my beneficiary not allowed?

cancel_transfer.meaning: Wants to cancel or reverse a transfer/payment they just made (e.g. sent to wrong account).
examples: Is it possible to cancel my transfer?
I made a payment to the wrong account, can you cancel it?

card_about_to_expire.meaning: Card is expiring or expired; how to get a replacement for an expiring card.
examples: My card is about to expire, how do I get a new one?

card_acceptance.meaning: Where the card is accepted / whether merchants or places accept it.
examples: Can I use my card everywhere?
Which stores accept this card?

card_arrival.meaning: Ordered card has not arrived yet; tracking the card in the post.
examples: My card hasn't arrived
I need to track the card sent to me.

card_delivery_estimate.meaning: How long card delivery takes, whether it can arrive by a date, express delivery, delivery to other countries.
examples: How long will it take to get my card?
Can I have it by a certain date?
Can the card be mailed to Europe?

card_linking.meaning: Linking/adding a card to the app or account, including re-adding or reactivating a card that was lost and then found, or showing a newly arrived card in the app.
examples: I found my lost card. Am I still able to use it?
Where in the app do I link a new card?
I found my lost card, can I add it back to the app?

card_not_working.meaning: Physical card not working in general, broken/damaged, or not working at multiple places / several times today (a single shop where the card did not work or was declined is declined_card_payment; not contactless, ATM or virtual).
examples: There is something wrong with my card, I tried it a few times today in different places and it didn't work.
My card isn't working
It has not worked at multiple places today.

card_payment_fee_charged.meaning: An unexpected fee was charged on a card payment/purchase.
examples: Why was I charged a fee for my card payment?
Why is there a fee associated with card use?

card_payment_not_recognised.meaning: A payment or charge on the account that the customer doesn't recognise or didn't make (unknown charge).
examples: Why is there an unknown charge showing on my account?
There is a card payment I'm not familiar with.
I didn't make a payment that shows in my app.

card_payment_wrong_exchange_rate.meaning: Wrong exchange rate applied to a card purchase/payment abroad.
examples: The exchange rate on my purchase is wrong.
The ATM ate my card

cash_withdrawal_charge.meaning: Fees for ATM cash withdrawals; charged for withdrawing cash; complaints about a fee on something they thought was free.
examples: Why did I get charged a fee, I thought it was free?
Why was I charged for withdrawing cash?
Is there a fee for ATM withdrawals?

cash_withdrawal_not_recognised.meaning: A cash withdrawal on the account the customer didn't make, even if they also ask to freeze the card.
examples: Please freeze my card, someone has withdrawn money using it and I did not do this withdrawal.
The app says I took out cash but I didn't!

change_pin.meaning: How to change or set the PIN.
examples: How do I change my PIN?

compromised_card.meaning: Card details may have been stolen / someone else may be using the card, fraud concern (card itself not lost).
examples: Someone might have access to my card!
I think my card details were stolen
Contactless isn't working

country_support.meaning: Which countries the service/account is available in or supports; using the account from a given country.
examples: Which countries are supported?
Can I get a card if I live in the US?

declined_card_payment.meaning: A (physical) card payment/purchase was declined, rejected, or the card did not work when paying in a shop/store. If a virtual/disposable card is rejected, that is virtual_card_not_working.
examples: My card wasn't working in a shop
My card payment was declined
Why was my card rejected at the store?

declined_cash_withdrawal.meaning: ATM cash withdrawal was declined/not authorised.
examples: I attempted to get cash but it was not authorized

declined_transfer.meaning: A transfer was declined/rejected, or the customer got a message saying the transfer is not possible / not allowed.
examples: I tried to transfer but it was declined
Just received a message that my transfer is not possible, I have done this before with no issues.

direct_debit_payment_not_recognised.meaning: An unrecognised direct debit, or being charged by mistake on the debit statement.
examples: I think I was charged by mistake on my debit statement.
There is a direct debit I didn't set up

disposable_card_limits.meaning: Limits/restrictions of disposable virtual cards (how many uses, how many cards).
examples: Can you give me the restrictions of the disposable cards?

edit_personal_details.meaning: Change name, address, phone or other personal/account details.
examples: How can I change my information?
I moved, can I edit my details?

exchange_charge.meaning: Fees or charges for currency exchange.
examples: What's the fee for exchanging currencies?
Are there extra charges for exchanging?

exchange_rate.meaning: What exchange rate is used, where to see rates, how rates are set (general; NOT about ATM/cash withdrawals, which is wrong_exchange_rate_for_cash_withdrawal).
examples: What is the exchange rate for EUR?
Where can I find your exchange rates?

exchange_via_app.meaning: How to exchange/convert currencies in the app, which currencies can be exchanged.
examples: How do I exchange currency in the app?
Can I exchange to euros?

extra_charge_on_statement.meaning: An unexplained extra fee or small extra amount, especially any £1/$1/€1 charge or transaction on the statement (even if described as unrecognised or pending). Other unrecognised charges/payments are card_payment_not_recognised.
examples: Why have I been charged an extra £1?
why was i charged
Why was I charged extra on my app?

failed_transfer.meaning: A transfer or large payment (e.g. for a flat/mortgage) failed, shows an error, did not go through, or the customer cannot make a transfer (no explicit decline message).
examples: I'm trying to make a payment for a flat and an error is appearing.
Why can I not make a transfer?
For some reason, I'm unable to transfer funds.
My transfer failed

fiat_currency_support.meaning: Which fiat currencies the account can hold, receive or support.
examples: What currencies can my account be in?
Do you support Euros?

get_disposable_virtual_card.meaning: How to get/create a disposable virtual card, who can get one.
examples: How do I get a disposable card?

get_physical_card.meaning: Getting a physical card, PIN for a new physical card; where to find card PIN.
examples: Where do I find my PIN?
Do I have a card PIN?

getting_spare_card.meaning: Getting an additional/extra/spare/another card (e.g. for a family member), how many cards one can have, fees for another card.
examples: What's the limit on total number of cards I can have?
How do I go about ordering another card?
Can I get a second card?

getting_virtual_card.meaning: How to get a (non-disposable) virtual card, where to find it.
examples: How can I locate the virtual card?
Can I get a virtual card?

lost_or_stolen_card.meaning: Card lost or stolen; wanting to freeze/block the card immediately (unless it is about a specific unrecognised transaction).
examples: How do I freeze my card immediately?
I believe that my card has been stolen!
I lost my card

lost_or_stolen_phone.meaning: Phone lost, stolen or left behind; using the account without the phone.
examples: I think my phone was stolen.
My phone is at the hotel, how can I use the app?

order_physical_card.meaning: Ordering a physical card, cost of a physical card, how to order.
examples: I need a physical card. What are the fees?
How do I order a card?

passcode_forgotten.meaning: Forgot the app passcode / password; resetting passcode.
examples: I forgot my passcode

pending_card_payment.meaning: A card payment is showing as pending / stuck.
examples: Why are my purchases pending?
What does it mean when a payment is pending?

pending_cash_withdrawal.meaning: A cash withdrawal is showing as pending.
examples: What does it mean when a cash withdrawal is pending?
My top-up appears to be pending.

pending_transfer.meaning: An outgoing transfer is described as pending / still in progress / still processing, even if the customer also asks how long it will take.
examples: It finally worked out but has been pending for a long time, how long do I wait?
I transferred money abroad hours ago and the transaction is still pending, how much longer?
I did a transfer but its still pending
How long will my transfer stay pending?

pin_blocked.meaning: PIN blocked after too many wrong attempts; unblock PIN/card.
examples: I entered my PIN wrong too many times

receiving_money.meaning: How to receive money / salary / payments from others into the account.
examples: Can my friend send me money?
Do I need to add my salary?

Refund_not_showing_up.meaning: A refund was promised/issued but hasn't appeared in the account yet.
examples: I am still waiting for a refund
my refund has not hit my account yet

request_refund.meaning: How to get a refund for a purchase; wants money back for something bought.
examples: I need a refund for something I bought.
How do I get a refund for an item?

reverted_card_payment?.meaning: A card payment was reverted/returned/cancelled and money came back.
examples: I made a payment but it was returned.
My card payment got reverted

supported_cards_and_currencies.meaning: Which cards (Visa, Mastercard, American Express, credit cards, foreign cards) and currencies are supported for top-up or use, including a specific card brand like Amex not working for adding money.
examples: Why doesn't it work when I use American Express to add money?
I want to top up with a credit card, which do you support?
Can you delete the account?

top_up_by_bank_transfer_charge.meaning: Fee for topping up by bank transfer.
examples: Is there a fee for topping up by bank transfer?

top_up_by_card_charge.meaning: Fee for topping up by card.
examples: what is the fee for topping up by card?
How much does it cost to top up a US-issued card?

top_up_by_cash_or_cheque.meaning: Topping up with cash or cheque, depositing cash.
examples: Is topping up with cash allowed?
How do I deposit cash?

top_up_failed.meaning: A top-up failed or was declined.
examples: My top up failed
My top-up didn't work

top_up_limits.meaning: Maximum/minimum top-up amounts or number of top-ups.
examples: Is there a limit to top-ups?
Can I use as many top-ups as I want?

top_up_reverted.meaning: A top-up was made/recharged but the account was not credited, it is not working and the customer doesn't know what happened to the money, or it went through and then was reversed/disappeared.
examples: I completed 3D secure for the top up but it's still not working, what happened to the money?
I have recharged topup but account is not credited.
I topped up but the money isn't in my account any more

topping_up_by_card.meaning: How to top up / add or transfer money using a (credit/debit) card; a card top-up where the money left the card but didn't show up.
examples: I'd like to transfer funds using my credit card.
What's the process for topping up my card?
I tried topping up with my card but the money is gone

transaction_charged_twice.meaning: Same transaction charged twice / duplicate charge.
examples: I was charged twice for the same thing

transfer_fee_charged.meaning: Charged a fee on a transfer, including complaints that transfers should be free, or higher fees for banking/sending money abroad.
examples: Why have I been charged a higher fee for doing banking abroad?
I thought transfers were free, now I see a strange fee after a purchase from abroad.
Why was my transfer charged a fee?

transfer_into_account.meaning: How to transfer/add money into the account from another bank account.
examples: I want to transfer money from another account into this one.

transfer_not_received_by_recipient.meaning: An outgoing transfer the customer sent (to a friend, landlord, in-country account) has not arrived / gone through / posted for the recipient, even if they confirmed the account details or ask how long it normally takes.
examples: I sent a transfer to a friend 2 hours ago and it still hasn't come through to her. How long does it take?
Why hasn't my in country transfer gone through yet? I confirmed the account info.
I made a transfer two days ago and it is still not showing up; the account number is right.
Why hasn't my son received the transfer I sent?

transfer_timing.meaning: How long transfers take to arrive, how much longer to wait for a transfer.
examples: It's been a couple days, how much longer do I have to wait for my transfer?
How long does a transfer take?

unable_to_verify_identity.meaning: Identity verification failing or not possible.
examples: The app failed to verify my id.
I can't do the verification.

verify_my_identity.meaning: How to verify identity, what documents are needed, how long verification takes.
examples: How do I validate my identity?
What documents do I need?
my money, where is it coming from?
Where do I see the source of my money?

verify_top_up.meaning: Verification code / verification process for topping up with a card.
examples: Where can I find the verification code for a top-up?

virtual_card_not_working.meaning: A virtual or disposable virtual card not working, rejected or declined when paying.
examples: My virtual card doesn't work
Why was my disposable virtual card rejected for a subscription?

visa_or_mastercard.meaning: Whether the card is Visa or Mastercard; wanting one or the other.
examples: Is this a Visa or Mastercard?
I need a Visa card

why_verify_identity.meaning: Why identity verification or personal info is required; reluctance or refusal to do the verification.
examples: Is it really necessary to verify my identity?
Why do you want so much personal info?

wrong_amount_of_cash_received.meaning: ATM gave the wrong amount of cash.
examples: The ATM only gave me 10 pounds instead of 30

wrong_exchange_rate_for_cash_withdrawal.meaning: ANY question or complaint about the exchange rate for cash withdrawals / ATMs abroad, including simply asking what rate applies when getting cash (not general exchange-rate questions).
examples: I wasn't given the correct exchange rate when getting cash
what is the exchange rate for foreign ATMs
what is the exchange rate when i get cash
